QuestInfo.name: Return to Maple Island
QuestInfo.0: Lucas, the chief of Maple Island, has a message for you. Something about a way to return to Maple Island?
QuestInfo.1: Lucas, the chief of Maple Island, has a message for you. Something about a way to return to Maple Island?
QuestInfo.2:
You've learned the skill #e#bMaple Return#k#n, which'll take you back to Maple Island!

#b* You'll be returned to the Maple Island docks when you use the skill. You can board a boat to Six Path Crossway from those docks.#k

0.0:
Hey there. I heard you became an Explorer. It's me, #bMai#k,
the chief of Amherst and Maple Island! 
#L0# #bLiar! You're not Mai!#l
#L1# Facial hair's a great look for you, Mai...#l
#k
0.1: I was joking. I just wanted to give you a little something, since you might get homesick.\r\n#L0# #bA present? Ooh, what is it?#l\n#k
0.2: It's a skill that lets you return to #bMaple Island#k whenever your little heart desires. You ready to learn it?

0.1: In your heart of hearts, I can tell you don't TRULY love Maple Island, so I can't give you my gift.

no.0: Come on, you know you'll end up accepting in the end...

yes.0: Just talk to #bVasily#k at the harbor anytime and he'll take you to Victoria Island. For now, I'll drop you off at #bSix Path Crossway#k. Real convenient location, that.
yes.1: Now you have no excuse not to visit us. Mai talks about you all the time. It's kind of annoying, actually.
